title: Microsoft 365 Outage Disrupts Outlook, Exchange Online and Teams
description: Microsoft 365 experienced a widespread outage affecting Outlook, Exchange Online, Teams, and other services due to failed server health checks. Microsoft has not found any evidence of a cyberattack and is still investigating the root cause. The outage caused service degradation but was not linked to recent patched vulnerabilities. The company is testing workarounds to restore service.
